name: Freed from the Hive
summary: At the Writhing Deep, Raschal lives, but the Zukk'ash hive has left him deeply stunned. He needs word sent to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Out of the Pod
sections.body: You help a night elf down from the pod, and he begins to stir. He names himself Raschal and says the bugs overwhelmed him, leaving him paralyzed inside. Though he looks healthy, he remains deeply stunned. He asks if the Stronghold sent you.

sections.title: Word for Feathermoon Stronghold
sections.body: Ginro Hearthkindle waits in Feathermoon Stronghold. Tell him Raschal lives and is well.

sections.title: Back at the Stronghold
sections.body: Raschal has reached the Stronghold and told Ginro what happened. Ginro says the whole Stronghold cannot begin to thank you. Raschal would have died without your timely arrival, and you asked for no mercenary's fee. Ginro names you a true hero and his friend for good.

faq.q: Who is trapped inside the Zukk'ash pod?
aliases: freed from the hive trapped elf
faq.answer: Raschal, a night elf and the missing courier, is trapped inside the Zukk'ash pod. The bugs overwhelmed him and left him paralyzed inside.

faq.q: Who do I tell once Raschal is free?
aliases: where to turn in freed from the hive
who do i talk to after freeing raschal
faq.answer: Tell Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold that Raschal is alive and well.

faq.q: What came before this in the search?
aliases: what quest comes before freed from the hive
faq.answer: The search follows The Writhing Deep, where you found the pod.
